calculation.description: Ranks assets for 10-day forward performance by reversing their 20-session volatility-normalized returns relative to the daily cross-sectional median; reversal exposure is reduced during rising-VIX regimes. All inputs are causal at signal date.

validation.regime_notes: 10d IC was positive in 2026-2028 (+0.05307, 605 dates), 2029-2031 (+0.04036, 783 dates), and 2032-2035 (+0.05234, 916 dates). 2023-2025 had no qualifying observations due to source history alignment. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
